pages.title: The Hollow Wood
paragraphs: The village gate closes behind them and the forest takes its place. The trees stand too close together and the birds have gone quiet. Maria's wedding ring is warm against her finger, and the Blood Emblem at her belt has begun to hum like a held breath.

Cypher stops first. "They're watching. Not us. You." Out in the dark, eyes catch the lantern light and do not look away. Seymour whispers that these woods were the island's hunting ground long before the city was built.
Aldermere lies at the far side of this wood. The road there is the one thing the curse has not yet closed.

pages.title: Defeat the Boss
paragraphs: Fell the Great Wolf at the heart of the clearing and the chapter is won. The wolves guarding him are not required kills, but they will not let you walk past. He is quick, and he carries something that will make anyone who takes it faster.
Feral wolves are fast, accurate and hit hard for their size. Fresh packs will race in from the edges of the wood on turns 5 and 10, so a long siege will not go well.
Wolves are beasts. Cypher's Fire tome and Maria's Beast Slayer both bite deeper against them. Bartz cannot carry this fight alone.

pages.title: Dense Undergrowth
paragraphs: Patches of thick undergrowth glow green. They give +20 Avoid and +2 Defense, but cost an extra point of movement to enter. Hold them yourself and the wolves will struggle to land a hit, but wolves standing in them are harder to hit as well.
Select a tile to inspect it. Whatever waits in the clearing carries something that may be worth the fight.
